notes: A Queens cat rescue founded in February 2026 by a former ACC staff member, working throughout Queens to foster and rehome cats and to support owners. Its form covers rehoming a cat and "Support with a pregnant cat or cat that recently had kittens." No phone number is published; use the form or email.
